specs.name: 롤 필드풍 — 차분한 청보라
specs.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create finished production BASE-COLOR artwork, soft hand-drawn fantasy-game environment art translated to this existing industrial panel geometry. BLUE-PURPLE palette throughout. The previous attempt was rejected for severe roughness and overdone damage: use clean, intact, beautifully painted surfaces. No rust, no copper chips, no chipped-paint clusters, no cracks, no scratch gashes, no speckle noise, no distressed/grunge overlays, no harsh impasto, no photographic or PBR gloss. Richness must come from controlled broad color planes, SOFT painted gradients, delicate hue shifts and readable bevel highlights, not wear. Surface detail is sparse and elegant. Do not make empty flat-color/vector graphics either. No labels, logos, text, symbols or glow. Single opaque square 2048x2048 texture, no borders/presentation board, no perspective render.
EDIT TARGET: supplied existing 4m FLOOR ALBEDO image. Preserve the exact flat top-down 2-by-2 square tile layout and seams at normalized x=0.5/y=0.5; opposite outer edges must match for tiling. Four equal 2m panels, do not subdivide. Paint soft inset shading, gentle hand-shaped bevel light, rounded subtly painted corner fasteners, clean satin surfaces. Tile centers have intentional broad hue/value planes and restrained softly blended brushwork, visually interesting but calm. All repeated geometry and any corner fittings stay near panel edges; do not add deep 3D relief. Texture image ONLY.
